name: Azalea Sara Rezenado
original_name: アゼリア・サーラ・リゼンアード
source:
Airheaded but strong, she is an adventuring warrior that Dorothy meets on her travels. She also wishes to defeat the Demon King like Dorothy, but her perspective on things are different.

While Dorothy views the miasma's effects on women to be troublesome, Azalea welcomes the pleasure that her body experiences. Although she does at times find it to be annoying.
